_comment: paper_minimum_threshold_8b_16gb.json, for resuming a run of it on the same 16 GB card. Only evaluation batch
sizes change, which a resume allows; anything that changes the experiment is refused (README 'Resuming a run').
The 20261031-061400 run ran out of memory in the validation pass at the end of the first introspection fold
from step 1500: four introspection prompts at once. decision_eval_batch_size stays at the 4 that ran ten hours
of decision training and evaluation without trouble; introspection_eval_batch_size drops to 1, for the
validation pass during introspection training and the reports asked after it.
In run_experiment.ipynb: SETTINGS_FILE = this file, RESUME_RUN_ID = the run's id, RESUME_FROM_STEP = 1500.
